source.title: Online Learning: A Modern Introduction Using Convex Optimization
source.anchor: Weighted entropy differential and Jensen comparison in the proof of Lemma 6.33, printed p. 80 / PDF p. 92.

target: The squared sum of absolute coordinate differences is bounded by an explicit rational sum, which is itself bounded by (Dψ(x)−Dψ(y))[x−y].

searched_existing: Public scalar ratio provider, coordinate differentiation, and finite weighted Jensen.
known_consumers: Three concrete checks: transverse derivative, distinct weighted points, equal points.
planned_consumers: Full weighted ℓ¹ strong convexity and subsequent KL results.
reuse_plan.decision_reason: Use weights wᵢ=(xᵢ+yᵢ)/(2cᵢ), whose sum is 1 because x and y both satisfy the weighted normalization. Apply Jensen to the square at |xᵢ−yᵢ|/wᵢ to obtain the first inequality. For the second, multiply the scalar ratio inequality by cᵢ and sum. Subtracting the two ambient derivatives cancels the constant terms.
